name: slotmirror
description: Mirror busy blocks between Microsoft 365 and Google calendars. Self-hosted on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm waitlist:check

SESSION_SECRET.description: Random string, at least 32 characters. Signs the session cookie.

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte key. Encrypts OAuth tokens at rest. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID.description: Application (client) ID of your Entra app registration. Leave empty if you do not use Microsoft 365.

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of your Entra app registration.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth client ID from Google Cloud. Leave empty if you do not use Google Calendar.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth client secret from Google Cloud.
